definitions.explanation: Painting in black ink, using only its shades and the white of the paper, or a picture painted this way.

examples.japanese: {墨絵|すみえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{濃淡|のうたん}→濃淡：05562_noutan⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧{墨絵|すみえ}。
examples.english: An ink painting made only with shades of ink.

examples.japanese: {雪舟|せっしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{墨絵|すみえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧{一色|いっしょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}えない→思える：32713_omoeru⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥行|おくゆ}き→奥行き：10569_okuyuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sesshū's ink paintings have a depth you would not expect from ink alone.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {墨絵|すみえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to paint in ink
- {墨絵|すみえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: a misty, monochrome scene

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水墨画|すいぼくが}→水墨画：27810_suibokuga⟧: ink-wash painting; the more formal, art-historical term
